name: Computer Health Checkup
description: Run a comprehensive health check of the user's computer — system info, disk, network, battery, and running apps — to proactively identify issues
prompt:
Run get_system_info, check_network, check_disk_health, get_battery_status. Present a SHORT report card — one line per category with a simple rating. Format:

Memory: [% used] — [rating]
Storage: [free space] — [rating]
Internet: [status] — [rating]
Battery: [level] — [rating]

Then ONE sentence about the most important thing to address (if any).
